p360.docusealDone: W-9, I-9, and Food Employee Reporting were sent to DocuSeal.
p360.docusealRetry: Check the DocuSeal setup and try again.
p360.sendToHiringBody: Confirm the transfer of the selected candidate. This opens or links the hiring process; it does not create an employee or start onboarding yet.
p360.willTransferBody: The candidate's identity, application, job, location, and selection result.
p360.willStayBody: Internal notes, decision history, evaluations, and the full audit trail.
p360.sendFailed: We couldn't send it to hiring
p360.sendFailedBody: The application couldn't be sent to the hiring process. Check whether one is already active.
p360.checkActive: Check whether a process is already active.
p360.formalizeBody: This creates or links the employee, keeps the record, and starts onboarding, signing, training, inventory, and access in a single transaction.
p360.alreadyHiredBody: This candidate already has an employee and a hiring flow linked.
p360.atomicNote: If any step fails, neither the employee nor the onboarding is created partially.
p360.authorizedEvaluator: An authorized evaluator has to complete the scorecard.
p360.scheduleToEvaluate: Schedule an interview to start evaluating this application.
p360.allEvaluated: The recorded interviews either have a scorecard or are closed.
p360.transitionWaiting: A transition is waiting for approval.
p360.transferHint: Sets up the next action without mixing processes
p360.offerAcceptedBody: The offer was accepted. Continue by sending documents.
p360.docsSentBody: Documents sent. Waiting for the candidate's signature.
p360.viewAccessNote: You have view access. Authorized owners have to perform the available actions.
p360.crossResultsHidden: Cross results appear once the evaluation policy allows revealing them.
p360.noInterviewScheduled: There's no interview scheduled yet. Use “Schedule interview” to create one.
p360.scheduleBody: Set the date, the format, and who runs the interview.
p360.checkAndRetry: Check the details and try again.
p360.waitingSignature: Waiting for documents to be signed
p360.step.reviewAndSchedule: Review the profile and schedule the interview.
p360.step.prepareOffer: Prepare the offer for the candidate.
p360.step.sendDocs: Send W-9, I-9, and Food Employee Reporting.
p360.step.hiringStarted: Hiring started. Complete the documents first.
p360.step.formalizeAfterDocs: Formalize the hire once the documents are complete.
apply.resumeOptionalBody: You can send it now or continue without a file. We'll ask for more only if the process needs it.
apply.signInToAutofill: Sign in or create an account only if you want us to read your resume and fill the form for you.
apply.name: Name
apply.readCalmly: Read it carefully before ticking the box. The content is the same; it's just written to be understood.
apply.canVerify: We can check what you tell us.
apply.noOneLiable: Nobody is liable for giving that information.
apply.mustBeTrue: The information has to be true.
apply.falseConsequences: If something is false or left out on purpose, your application can be rejected, and if you were already hired your employment can be ended.
apply.notAContract: This is not an employment contract.
apply.checkStatus: You can check the status in the candidate portal with the same email and access.
apply.onlyRequired: Only the questions marked required have to be filled in.
apply.optionalReuse: This is optional. If you fill it in, you won't have to type it again next time you apply.
apply.lastJobHint: Tell us about your most recent job. If it doesn't apply, you can leave these blank.
apply.whatYouSeek: What kind of work you're looking for
apply.whatYouSeekHint: Tell us what kind of work you're looking for.
apply.referencesHint: Add up to three work or personal references we can contact.
apply.canWorkUs: Can you legally work in the United States?
apply.workedHereBefore: Have you worked for this company before?
apply.whenAndRole: Tell us when and in what role
apply.familyWorksHere: Does a relative of yours work here?
apply.whoAndRole: Tell us who and in what role
apply.felony: Have you been convicted of a felony?
apply.canContactSupervisor: Can we contact your previous supervisor?
apply.explainWorked: if you answered yes, explain when you worked for this company
apply.explainFamily: if you answered yes, explain which relative works for this company
apply.explainFelony: if you answered yes, explain the conviction
apply.wrongPassword: That password doesn't match this account. Try again or request a link to reset it.
apply.accountExists: An account already exists with this email. Select “I already have an account” and enter your password.
apply.cvAnalysisDown: Secure resume analysis is temporarily unavailable. You can send the application without the file, or save it and come back later.
apply.writeName: Write your name so we know who you are.
apply.checkEmail: Check your email address: something looks missing.
apply.passwordMin: Create a password of at least 10 characters so you can follow your application.
apply.checkBox: Tick the box at the end to confirm your details are correct.
apply.saveFailed: We couldn't save your progress. Try again before leaving.
apply.reviewBeforeContinue: Check the information available before continuing.
